experiments.scope: The 38-step compression, the P8 data and the claw maps of the shipped program (proof.md Sections 2 and 3). Trial 0 builds the two kernel images for the P8 chaining value PCV, executes both images on 256 random lanes against the scalar walk step (29 output planes and the distinguished-point plane compared lane by lane), and runs the shipped claw_core on the P8 pair (a0 = A0, head of E16x, u = W1): the exact claw test, the post-filters C1, C2, G, F7 on the real words and step 3b (both second blocks, two 38-step compressions, exact comparison). Trials 1 to 255 draw a chaining value and a point pair (x on the a0 side, y on the u side) of the walk's encoding from the trial seed and check the row-16 identity F(a0) + P(u) = E16x on the real step-0..16 trace, W1 = u, and that the program's claw predicate equals 'E16x is a row-16 pass of P8 with the point's head'. Every trial output is verified by hard assert statements in r38joint.py._e1; no collision is expected (message fields are null).
experiments.hypothesis: Hard-asserted in r38joint.py._e1. Trial 0: accepted 1, claws 1, c1 1, c2 1, g 1, f7 1, step3b 1, sfs_collision 1, kernel_lanes 512, kernel_bad 0 (both kernel images agree with the scalar step on every lane) (the P8 pair is a claw of its own chaining value and step 3b accepts it as a second-block collision); kernel_records <= 1300, kernel_regs <= 240. Trials 1..255: identity 1, w1_is_u 1, claw_iff_r16 1 (the claw predicate (F(a0) - t_j 2^13) - (H_0 - P(u)) in {0,1,4,5,1024,1025,1028,1029} holds iff the real E16x of the P1 pair equals head H_j on the 29 bits outside {0, 2, 10}); quot_match is an observation (1 iff the two points collide under the walk step).

experiments.scope: Trials 0 to 3 run four independent windows of the shipped program in check mode (every parameter of class P unchanged except the window length: 2^20 walk evaluations = 4096 iterations of 256 lanes instead of 2^25) on first blocks drawn from the trial seeds: the bit-sliced kernel, the bucketed distinguished-point table, stage 2, the claw decode, the exact claw test, the post-filters and step 3b. Check mode asserts, for every claw, F(a0) against the scalar map, the difference in the offset set, the real E16x in S160 with the point's head, and the post-filter words W7, W8, W9 of both members against the real rows of the P1 pair. Trials 4..255 return no observation.
experiments.hypothesis: Hard-asserted in r38joint.py._e2: every assertion of check mode holds on every claw of the four windows (the claw against the scalar maps, the real E16x and the real words W7, W8, W9 of both members). The frozen counts WIN_EXP were measured on the trial seeds of a local repository copy with a different target-config hash, so their count asserts do not fire for the organizer's seeds (proof.md Section 8); the window counts are returned as observations. No collision is expected at this size (message fields are null).

experiments.scope: The estimator layer of the registered deep-rate run O (proof.md Section 7a), not the sampling: the program carries, for each of the 360 (head subset, block) seeds, the measurement tool's printed prefix_log2 and the EXACT and SAMPLES counts of the two arms (u condition on and off), and recomputes from them every per-seed Lr = prefix_log2 + log2(EXACT / SAMPLES) + 27, the subset mixture Y_k of each block, its one-sided 99% Ville lower bound (the charged q3r), the linear mean and the Student-t statistic, the per-subset table, the u0 arm and the paired u effect. Trial 0 does this; trials 1..255 return nothing. The sampling (720 runs of the C tool q3walk.c, 28-56 s each) is participant-run and not executed here. No message pair is produced (fields null).
experiments.hypothesis: Hard-asserted in q3data.py.check: every recomputed statistic of EXPECT (the charged bound, the mixture statistics, the per-subset values, the u0 arm, the paired u effect, the EXACT totals) equals the value printed in proof.md Section 7a (EXPECT, tolerance 1e-9 bit; integer totals exactly), including the charged Ville bound log2 = -71.193877658 of the u1 mixture over 72 blocks, and the Ville bound does not exceed the linear mean. Observations of trial 0 are the recomputed values.
